member.summary:
Years of a text, used for the year context of a number hit and a source quote. A year is a four-digit number from 1990 to 2100 that is not part of a longer number, an amount ($2000, Rs. 2000, 2000 €) or a percentage; digits of other scripts are read as ASCII digits (see ). Years that are part of a legal source reference are ignored, because they name the document, not the year of a value:
directly after Notice, Pub. or Rev., also with a word (Rev. Guide 2024) or a revision with month (Rev. 12-2025, Rev. December 2025)
in a document number with hyphen or slash (2024-40, décret n° 2024-1234, Regulation (EU) 2016/679); this also skips ISO dates (2025-01-01), a range of full years (2024-2026) is kept
in parentheses after a statute reference (Bill 951 (2022), Act 32 (2020))
after a number with slash (No. 57/2023, BGBl. II Nr. 123/2025, Ley 35/2006, Real Decreto 1/2026) or a number of a year (Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021)
after an enactment title (Finance Act, 2025, Income-tax Rules, 1962, Social Security Act 1991) or an official gazette (BGBl. I 2025 Nr. 12, Stb. 2024, 123)
in the date of an enactment (Gesetz vom 20. Dezember 2024, loi du 23 décembre 2024, legge 30 dicembre 2024), unless the date starts a validity
in a print or typesetting mark, a date with a time (15:14 - 3-Dec-2025, 16:58 Oct 31, 2025, Sep 11 2014 16:58): a document is printed before the year it is valid for
in a number row, another number within 12 characters on both sides without a word, colon or parenthesis in between (wage bracket table 1965 1995 32.50); years of an enumeration or range are no such number
A citation that is not recognized counts as year, as does the year of a numeric date (17.09.2026, 01.01.2025-31.12.2025), also within a number row. A validity start (effective January 1, 2025, beginning on or after January 1, 2025, from 1 July 2025, 2025 and after, ab dem 1. Januar 2025) and the year of an unchanged value (unchanged from 2024, same as 2024, unverändert seit 2024) are kept but marked: up to the relevant year they rate a hit neutral. A year enumeration (2024, 2025, or 2026, 2024 and 2025, 2024 und 2025) and a year range (2024-2026, 2024 through 2026, 2024 bis 2026) are one year group. A tax year period (2025-26, FY 2025-26, FY26, AY 2026-27, YA 2027) is one hit with its income years (see ). The words of the languages apply (see ). A number with a year-weak hit and no positive hit is (see ); a source quote with the relevant year anchors the numbers it holds.
